- [Connect for Buyers](https://admin.corpsite.pubmatic.com/products/connect-for-buyers/): Connect brings you closer to your customer with efficient, ROI\-driven data targeting on the sell side\. Connect combines platform technology and dedicated service to enhance how inventory and data are packaged and transacted — putting you ahead of the competition, today and tomorrow\.
- [Connect for Publishers](https://admin.corpsite.pubmatic.com/products/connect-for-publishers/): Connect brings you future\-proofed revenue opportunities, while maintaining the highest level of security and respect for user privacy\.
